verdict.rationale: Modal documents automatic container lifecycle: containers spin up and down in 1-2 seconds, and endpoints idle at zero, which supports paying only for what runs. Its Python SDK can programmatically interact with the platform, but no evidence documents explicit start, stop, restart, or terminate operations on instances. Missing for 10: documented programmatic stop/restart/terminate APIs for containers or sandboxes, explicit per-second or usage-based billing tied to running state, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start, stop, restart, and terminate instances programmatically and keep paying only for what is running

citations.quote: In contrast, _Modal spins containers_ up and down in 1-2 seconds.
Turn any function into an HTTPS endpoint that scales with traffic and idles at zero.
The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
